name: Wispr Flow glow
description: While you dictate with Wispr Flow, the screen edges glow in the wallpaper's colours and ripple with your voice, with an idle wave when the mic is quiet; errors turn the glow red and arrive as notifications. Wispr's own bottom bar stays hidden. Successor of the wispr-glow 0.1.3 bundle (edge-aura, wispr-flow, wispr-status-hidden).
